blocks.tamil_translation: anew, (all his previous sins having been forgiven)” — Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this Hadith Qudsi through the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ وُعِكَ لَيْلَةً فَصَبَرَ وَرَضِيَ بِهَا عَنِ اللهِ خَرَجَ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِهِ كَيَوْمٍ وَلَدَتْهُ اُمُّهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ابي الدنيا في كتاب الرضي وغيره الترغيب:٤ /٢٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever has a fever for one night, and bears it with patience, and even in that fever remains content with Allah Ta'ala, becomes pure from his sins like a newborn child” — Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ رَفَعَهُ اِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَقُوْلُ اللهُ : مَنْ اَذْهَبْتُ حَبِيْبَتَيْهِ فَصَبَرَ وَاحْتَسَبَ لَمْ اَرْضَ لَهُ ثَوَاباً دُوْنَ الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في ذهاب البصر رقم:٢٤٠١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whichever servant's two beloved things (his two eyes) I take away, and he bears it and places his hope in Me for its good and its reward, I will not be pleased to give him any gift less than Jannah” — Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this Hadith Qudsi through the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِيْ مُوْسي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ إِذَا مَرِضَ الْعَبْدُ أَوْ سَافَرَ كُتِبَ لَهُ مِثْلُ مَا كَانَ يَعْمَلُ مُقِيْمًا صَحِيْحًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري, باب يكتب للمسافر ..., رقم:٢٩٩٦
blocks.tamil_translation: When a servant falls ill or goes on a journey, (since he is unable to do deeds because of the illness or because of the journey) the reward of the deeds he did when he was healthy or
